_about: Jerry Lyons' ONE shared record of market numbers. Written by the Website market update routine (monthly, Maryland REALTORS) and the Monday website check (weekly Freddie Mac rate) at the same time they update the website. Every other agent (FB/IG market post, LinkedIn, Google Business, chat agent) reads numbers ONLY from here. Never estimate; if the month you need isn't here yet, wait. Newest month first. HEADLINE RULE (Jerry, 2026-11-15): the overall/headline market number is Bright MLS's 'Baltimore Metro' figure (baltimore_metro block, labeled 'Baltimore area' / 'Baltimore Metro'); Baltimore County and Baltimore City (Maryland REALTORS) go underneath as supporting numbers. Never combine or estimate.
